title: SMB (445) open on 192.168.1.20
remediation: SMB on a network perimeter is a prime ransomware vector.

title: Open network: Cafe Free WiFi
remediation: Use WPA3-SAE (or WPA2-AES at minimum). Never use an open network for sensitive traffic.

title: WEP is broken: Legacy-WEP
remediation: Replace the AP or switch to WPA2-AES/WPA3 immediately. WEP cannot be made safe.

title: Open network with a randomized BSSID
remediation: Treat as untrusted. Check for rogue DHCP/DNS before connecting.

title: WPS advertised: SentinelLab-IoT
remediation: Turn off WPS in the AP configuration.

title: HTTPS (443) open on 192.168.1.1
remediation: Audit TLS version, cipher suites and certificate validity.

title: HTTP (80) open on 192.168.1.1
remediation: Prefer HTTPS with HSTS; check for default admin pages.
